beats: setting: Zuzu's cozy garden with sunflowers, daisies, and a tiny pink hut; event: Zuzu finds an extra-large, extra-sweet carrot growing in her garden. She smiles, thinking of how much she loves big carrots.; temptation: Eat the carrot all by herself right now.; the right choice: Put the carrot aside to show her friend later.

setting: The village park with a swing set, a round fountain, and green grass; event: Zuzu sees her friend, a squirrel named Pip, looking sad because he dropped his favorite nut.; temptation: Ignore Pip and keep walking with her carrot.; the right choice: Offer Pip her extra-large carrot to cheer him up.

setting: A sunny meadow filled with butterflies and dandelions; event: Zuzu spots a lost baby bird that can’t fly yet. The baby bird chirps loudly, looking hungry.; temptation: Leave the baby bird alone and go play.; the right choice: Give the baby bird a small piece of her carrot to eat.

setting: Zuzu’s treehouse, high up with a view of the whole forest; event: Zuzu’s sister, Lila, visits and says she’s bored because she has no toys to play with.; temptation: Tell Lila to go find something else and keep her toys to herself.; the right choice: Share one of her favorite toys with Lila.

setting: The forest trail lined with tall pine trees and soft moss; event: Zuzu and Pip come across a shy hedgehog who has dropped all her berries.; temptation: Take the hedgehog’s berries for herself.; the right choice: Help the hedgehog pick up the berries and give her a few extra from her pocket.

setting: The village bakery, smelling of warm bread and cinnamon; event: The baker gives Zuzu one extra muffin because she was so kind earlier that day.; temptation: Eat the muffin secretly without telling anyone.; the right choice: Give the muffin to the first person she sees who looks sad.

setting: Zuzu’s bedroom, filled with stuffed animals, books, and a big window; event: Zuzu finds a shiny, beautiful stone while cleaning her shelf. She loves how it sparkles.; temptation: Keep the stone all to herself and brag about it.; the right choice: Give the stone to Pip, who has been collecting shiny things for his treasure box.

setting: The village square, where everyone gathers for the weekly celebration; event: Zuzu stands with Pip, Lila, and the hedgehog, all smiling and laughing together. The whole village cheers for their kindness.; temptation: Let the moment pass without saying anything.; the right choice: Stand up and tell everyone, ‘Sharing makes us all happier!’
